title: Recording: Step Lightly, You And Me (Babe) by Ringo Starr | 1973
content:
Producers Workshop, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr worked on two songs for his third studio album, Ringo, on 10 July 1973.

This was an overdub session. The backing track for ‘Step Lightly’ had been recorded on 9 March at Sunset Sound Recorders in Los Angeles, and was completed during this session.

The second song, ‘You And Me (Babe)’ had been recorded on 8 March. More additions were taped on 12 May and 29 June, and it too was completed on this day.
